fsid.description: Unique cluster identifier (UUID). Must be identical across all nodes in the cluster.

public_network.description: List of CIDR notation networks for public (client-facing) communication.

cluster_network.description: List of CIDR notation networks for internal cluster traffic (replication, heartbeats).

auth_cluster_required.description: Authentication required for daemon-to-daemon communication (e.g., osd, mon, mds).

auth_service_required.description: Authentication required for client-to-daemon communication (services like MDS/RBD).

auth_client_required.description: Authentication required for client access to the cluster (e.g., rbd, rgw).

mon_host.description: IP addresses or hostnames of monitor nodes. Used during bootstrap if monitors aren't auto-discovered.

log_to_stderr.description: If true, log to stderr (useful when running under systemd). Otherwise logs go to 'log file'.

log_file.description: Path to the main Ceph log file (used when log_to_stderr is false).

osd_max_backfills.description: Maximum number of backfill operations per OSD (backfill = full copy during rebalancing).

osd_max_truesyncs.description: Maximum number of true sync (full replica repair) operations per OSD.

osd_op_threads.description: Number of threads for handling client requests per OSD.

osd_recovery_op_threads.description: Number of threads for recovery/backfill operations per OSD.

osd_auto_discover.description: Whether to automatically discover devices (e.g., via udev). Set to false if manually managing devices.

osd_journal_size.description: Size (in MiB) of the journal for filestore OSDs (ignored for bluestore).

osds.description: List of OSD instances managed on this node. Each entry represents a single OSD.

id.description: OSD ID (e.g., 0 for osd.0). Must be unique within the cluster.

key.description: Secret key for the OSD (generated by ceph auth). Required for authentication.

data_path.description: Data directory path for the OSD (must match ceph-volume layout: /var/lib/ceph/osd/ceph-{id}).

journal_path.description: Journal device/file path (only for filestore OSDs). Leave empty for bluestore.

block_path.description: Block device path (for bluestore OSDs). Typically a fast disk or partition.

block_db_path.description: Block device for DB/WAL separation in bluestore (e.g., NVMe for metadata).

block_wal_path.description: Block device for WAL in bluestore (for high-performance latency-sensitive setups).

hostname.description: Hostname to use for CRUSH hierarchy placement. Improves data distribution awareness.
